WITH counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as rec_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(rec_count) as total_count FROM counts
)
SELECT 
  c.tradekind,
  c.rec_count,
  c.rec_count * 100.0 / t.total_count as share
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY c.rec_count DESC;
